name: Kwai

disclosure.zh: Kwai 没有电脑网页上传：把打包好的视频传到手机，用 Kwai App 发布，复制 post.md 里的文案。AI 生成内容请在文案里说明。
disclosure.en: Kwai has no desktop web upload: move the packaged video to your phone and post it in the Kwai app, pasting the copy from post.md. Say in the caption when the video is AI-made.

guide.zh: 在手机上发：打开 Kwai → 「+」→ 从相册选视频 → 粘贴文案 → 发布。发完回来点「标记已发布」并贴上链接。
guide.en: Post from the phone: Kwai → + → pick the video from the gallery → paste the caption → Post. Then come back, Mark as posted and paste the link.

notes: TODO by design: kwai.com is a viewing / marketing site and Kwai Studio (PC) is for live streaming only - no web upload page to fill (checked 2026-10).
Fill is disabled; packaging, the checklist and mark-as-posted still work.
